sessionStart.powershell: if ($env:GITHUB_ACTIONS -eq 'true' -or $null -ne $env:COPILOT_AGENT_PROMPT) { exit 0 }; $bash=Get-Command bash.exe -All -CommandType Application | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path (Split-Path $_.Source -Parent) 'git.exe') } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $bash) { Write-Error 'Firstmate Copilot primary sessions are unsupported on native Windows. Use macOS, Linux, or WSL; Windows Zellij support is a separate experimental backend.'; exit 2 }; & $bash.Source -c './bin/fm-copilot-hook.sh session-start'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
